text:
alexa: Quick pass on the notification preview tray in SLO edit — keyboard focus can't reach action chips after opening. Also screen readers announce the channel count as a 'button' and the compact labels feel terse. Can we triage?

 dave: Repro steps? I'll add an acceptance test.

 alexa: Steps: SLO > Edit threshold > focus the compact action row > open preview (Enter) > Shift+Tab to go back. Focus gets trapped inside the tray and action chips (Assign owner / Pause alerts / Fallback policy) are unreachable. NVDA on Chrome.

 lina: I can repro. The tray uses a focus trap while the action row is rendered outside the overlay root. Short-term: inject a keyboard-only "Skip to actions" link at the top of the tray that targets #threshold-actions. Long-term: render the action row inside the tray DOM.

 omar: Microcopy: the compact toggle currently shows 'Mute' which product finds ambiguous. Proposal: visible label 'Pause alerts' + aria-describedby referencing hidden text: 'Pause alerts for this SLO for the selected duration.' Keeps UI compact but clear for assistive tech.

 aria-bot: Accessibility checklist: tray should have role="dialog" and aria-labelledby="tray-title". Channel-count must be plain text with aria-live="polite" and phrased as a sentence, e.g. 'Preview — 2 channels configured'. Toggle should be a real button with aria-pressed and aria-describedby pointing to the SR text. Ensure the hidden description exists before the control in the DOM.

 dave: Plan: 1) add a focusable .sr-only skip link when tray mounts; 2) add role/aria-labelledby to tray header; 3) change channel count to span + aria-live; 4) swap toggle markup to button with aria-pressed + aria-describedby; 5) swap copy: 'Mute' -> 'Pause alerts', 'Assign' -> 'Assign owner', 'Fallback' -> 'Fallback policy'. I'll open a small PR covering these and include a CSS rule to make the skip link visible on focus.

 lina: I'll update the design system docs and include the SR snippet for the compact row component.

 omar: Ping me the staging link when it's up; I'll run VoiceOver and NVDA checks.

 deploy-bot: deploy-preview:staging created for PR #2201 — https://deploys.redwood/inference/2201

 alexa: Thanks everyone. Priorities for this patch: skip-link + aria-labelledby + toggle semantics + copy swaps. Follow-up: DOM refactor to reparent actions into the tray. Closing after merge. :white_check_mark:
